name: Tablet Lite
author: maxt
description: The simplified tablet experience: virtual keyboard and voice input only. On-screen wvkbd keyboard (Ctrl/Super/Alt, F-keys, number row, arrows, a ▼ collapse key) plus voxtype hold-to-talk with Delete/Clear/Enter, a caret pad and a CLI-keys grid for touch-only terminals.

barWidget.description: On-screen keyboard toggle + voice input (voxtype hold-to-talk)
